title_tr: Etkinlik kaydı eski durumu yanlış gösteriyor
issue: The activity log shows 'in_progress -> in_progress' when a task is started, instead of 'todo -> in_progress'. The previous status is wrong in every status change entry.

ground_truth.root_cause: TaskService.change_status publishes TASK_STATUS_CHANGED with old_status=status (the new status) instead of the saved old_status; the activity log just formats what it receives.
